assumptions.levels: skill level with items = base level

formulas.melee_hit: weapon_avg * (srcdam / 128) * (100 + ED + stat bonuses) / 100 * hit_chance; ED from calc (see calc_desc), phys from phys.*

tags: V run unless a field says otherwise: values are game.exe 1.14d's own functions run in the emulator (docs/research/decomp29-skilldamage.md)

units.synergy_sets: none = the skill alone at its level; all1 / all20 = every other skill at 1 / 20 points (only skills the calc names count)
